Wiring B: both joined wires flipped. Door opens. 2 flips.
ex_m.cnt1: Counted as 1 flip. Wiring B then needs only 2 flips and looks weaker than Wiring A (3 flips; result word only, the accept flag itself falls to 1 flip).
ex_m.cnt2: Counted once per place it feeds. Wiring B then needs 3 flips, the same as A. (All 32 rebuilds needed 3 this way. Measured on small designs from one recipe, result word only; the accept flag itself falls to 1 flip. Not shown physical.)
ex_m.clip_fq10: Copies that meet at one point may count as one.
ex_m.clip_fq25: In a computer model, how many glitches fool a lock depends on where its backup copies meet and how you count; nothing physical was tested.
